limitations: Requires exact entire distance law; reconstruction from empirical histograms may be ill-conditioned near rectangular and coincident-threshold shapes.
Does not distinguish orientation reversing isometries and makes no higher-dimensional rigidity or finite-sample claim.
External independent audit not performed and a historical equivalent formulation may exist.
scientific_integrity: Theorem concerns exact Haar pairwise intrinsic-distance CDF on every planar flat torus; the full proof uses polar Voronoi area, isolated angular arc births, and Gauss reduction. Mathematical originality is assessed against specified accessible sources, not independently certified.
title: Intrinsic-distance histograms determine every flat two-torus
